input.summary: V02 Tungabhadra Actives (distributor) quoted 7 lines (RM-001, 003, 004, 005, 006, 009, 010) and explicitly declined RM-007 (hydroxyethylcellulose); no mention of RM-002 glycerin or RM-008 rosemary, so those are silent and not recorded. Odd points: RM-004 is offered as 75% panthenol in water against a 98% active spec; RM-006 has no strength figure, only a 90:10 ratio; peptides (RM-009/010) are from an unnamed overseas manufacturer, have no temperature logger, and are excluded from the 4% trade discount; the vendor refuses to share rejection or delivery records; the niacinamide COA is issued on behalf of the manufacturer.
